title: Lighter on Slower PCs
summary: A new Low-end mode in Settings, and the Head Database no longer draws hundreds of heads at once.

sections.heading: Performance
items: New Low-end mode in /bb settings: the Head Database draws far fewer heads at once
The Head Database now draws at most 150 heads at a time, even on a big window with a small GUI scale, so it is much lighter on the GPU
Smaller head cache, so the screen uses less memory over a long session
